fallback.description: Plain-text equivalent for clients that cannot render Gen UI, and for search, notifications and screen readers.

tone.description: A semantic tone for meaning (`success` good, `warning` needs attention, `danger` bad or destructive, `accent` highlighted, `neutral`), or a colour name for telling categories apart. The shared theme owns every hue.

color.description: A colour name. The shared theme owns the exact hue, in light and dark; a document never names one.

icon.description: Icon name, drawn from the shared icon set in `icons/`. An unknown name draws no icon.

src.description: Path of an image file stored with the document, relative to it (for example `assets/coast.jpg`). Remote URLs are refused in v1: add the image as a file first.

alt.description: Text alternative. Shown if the image fails to load and read by screen readers.

text.description: Short label, shown exactly as written (no case change). Keep under 16 characters.
Sent as the user's next message in the conversation.

url.description: https URL, or a path the host knows how to open.

name.description: Tool the host is asked to run.

id.description: Suggested secret name: 2–32 characters, a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`. When it names an existing secret, the form changes that secret instead of creating one.

description.description: Suggested description of the secret, at most 2,000 characters.

name.description: Environment variable name, `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`, unique ignoring case.

description.description: What the value is or where to find it, at most 2,000 characters.

variables.description: The variables the agent needs, in order.

secret.description: What the Happy Agent secret form starts with. The person may change every field before saving. It never holds a value: values are typed by the person.

id.description: An existing cluster secret to change: 24 characters, a lowercase letter then lowercase letters and digits. Its type must match; the server checks at submit. Absent: the form creates one.

name.description: Suggested name: 1–100 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

owner.description: Suggested owner: `me` for the person's own secret, `team` for the organization's. The form starts at `me` when absent.

uses.description: Suggested parts of the system that may open the value, each at most once.

host.description: A host name or address, 1–253 characters. Or `*.` and a name, matching its subdomains.

pathPrefixes.description: Paths starting with `/`, each at most 256 characters. `/v1` admits `/v1` and `/v1/…`. Absent: any path.

targets.description: Requests the egress proxy applies the value to.

prefix.description: At most 32 printable ASCII characters sent before the value, such as `Bearer `.

headers.description: The headers the proxy sets, each to its prefix followed by the value. The form asks one value per header.

algorithm.description: How the proxy sends the value.

public.description: Suggested public metadata of an endpoint secret.

id.description: An existing cluster secret to change: 24 characters, a lowercase letter then lowercase letters and digits. Its type must match; the server checks at submit. Absent: the form creates one.

name.description: Suggested name: 1–100 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

owner.description: Suggested owner: `me` for the person's own secret, `team` for the organization's. The form starts at `me` when absent.

uses.description: Suggested parts of the system that may open the value, each at most once.

hosts.description: Hosts the key signs for: names, addresses, or `*.name` patterns, each 1–253 characters.

knownHosts.description: Plain `known_hosts` lines, each at most 8,192 characters.

public.description: Suggested public metadata of an SSH key secret. The public key and fingerprint come from the key the person enters.

id.description: An existing cluster secret to change: 24 characters, a lowercase letter then lowercase letters and digits. Its type must match; the server checks at submit. Absent: the form creates one.

name.description: Suggested name: 1–100 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

owner.description: Suggested owner: `me` for the person's own secret, `team` for the organization's. The form starts at `me` when absent.

uses.description: Suggested parts of the system that may open the value, each at most once.

server.description: One host name or address, 1–253 characters, never a pattern.

port.description: Integer port 1–65535, only when the server is not on 22 (SSH) or 443 (HTTPS).

knownHosts.description: Plain `known_hosts` lines, each at most 8,192 characters.

username.description: 1–128 characters. Absent: the token is sent as a bearer token.

method.description: How git authenticates. The form asks the key, password or token.

repos.description: Patterns such as `owner/repo` or `owner/*`, each at most 256 characters. Absent: every repository on the server.

operations.description: What the credential may do, each at most once. Only the `ssh_key` method may `sign`.

public.description: Suggested public metadata of a git credential.

id.description: An existing cluster secret to change: 24 characters, a lowercase letter then lowercase letters and digits. Its type must match; the server checks at submit. Absent: the form creates one.

name.description: Suggested name: 1–100 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

owner.description: Suggested owner: `me` for the person's own secret, `team` for the organization's. The form starts at `me` when absent.

uses.description: Suggested parts of the system that may open the value, each at most once.

variables.description: Variable names, each `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`, at most 128 characters and unique. The form asks one value per name.

public.description: Suggested public metadata of an environment secret.

secret.description: What the Happy Cloud secret form starts with, by secret type. It never holds a value: the form asks for each. Every field is a suggestion the person may change. A valid prefill is not necessarily a secret the cluster accepts; the cluster checks the saved form by its own rules.

plugin.description: The plugin whose page the host opens. Installing happens there; the tap installs nothing.

action.description: What happens when the user activates an interactive element. The renderer reports it; the host decides whether and how to run it, and may ask for confirmation or refuse. An action a host cannot run leaves its element disabled.

id.description: Optional stable name for a node, unique in the document. Lets a later edit or action refer to it.

oneOf.title: card
oneOf.description: The standard root: a bordered surface with a header, content and a footer of actions.

badge.description: Status label at the trailing edge of the header.

oneOf.title: stack
oneOf.description: A vertical group of children with standard spacing. Use as the root when no card frame is wanted.

oneOf.title: row
oneOf.description: A horizontal group whose children share the width equally.

oneOf.title: section
oneOf.description: A titled group inside a card.

oneOf.title: text
oneOf.description: A paragraph of text with inline Markdown.

text.description: Inline Markdown: bold, italic, inline code and links. No headings, lists, images or HTML.

variant.description: `title` is a heading, `caption` is small and muted.

text.description: Short label, shown exactly as written (no case change). Keep under 16 characters.

oneOf.title: stat
oneOf.description: One headline number with an optional change and sparkline.

value.description: The number, already formatted by the author (`$1.24M`, `8,412`, `2.1%`).

deltaLabel.description: What the change is measured against (`vs Q2`).

trend.description: Direction arrow next to the delta.

tone.description: Colour of the delta and sparkline. Defaults from `trend`: up = success, down = danger, flat = neutral. Set it when down is good.

spark.description: Values for a small sparkline, oldest first.

oneOf.title: keyvalue
oneOf.description: A definition list of label/value pairs.

icon.description: Describes the label; drawn before it.

tone.description: Kind of notice. A colour name tints it and behaves as `neutral`.

icon.description: Overrides the default icon for the tone (neutral, accent and colour names = info, success = check, warning and danger = alert).

oneOf.title: code
oneOf.description: A block of code with a copy control.

text.description: The code. Newlines and indentation are preserved.

language.description: Language id for highlighting (`ts`, `sql`, `json`, `bash`...). Unknown values render unhighlighted.

title.description: File name or caption in the header.

oneOf.title: chart
oneOf.description: A line, area, bar or donut chart.

labels.description: X categories in order, or slice names for a donut.

color.description: Colour of this series, for telling series apart. Without it the series takes the shared chart palette in order. A donut ignores it.

emphasis.description: Highlight this series; series without it are drawn muted.

series.description: One or more series. A donut uses only the first.

suffix.description: Put after every number, including any space (` ms`, `%`).

format.description: How axis and value labels are written.

totalLabel.description: Donut only: caption under the total in the centre.

oneOf.title: table
oneOf.description: A small table of text, numbers and badges.

key.description: Property name of this column in each row.

columns.description: Columns in order. The first column names the row.

rows.description: One object per row, keyed by column `key`. A cell is a string, or `{ text, tone }` for a badge or a tinted value.

oneOf.title: list
oneOf.description: Rows of rich items, optionally tappable.

icon.description: Leading icon. Ignored when `image` is set or the list is `ordered`.

trailing.description: Short trailing text (`2h`, `$48`). Keep under 8 characters.

action.description: Makes the row tappable and adds a chevron.

ordered.description: Number the rows instead of showing icons.

oneOf.title: steps
oneOf.description: A vertical timeline of steps with their status.

time.description: Short trailing text, already formatted (`1m 08s`). Shown only when given.

value.description: Fraction complete, 0 to 1. Values outside the range are clamped.

tone.description: Fill colour. `neutral` uses the platform's primary ink.

oneOf.title: gallery
oneOf.description: A set of images as a mosaic grid or a carousel of cards.

title.description: Carousel card title; the viewer caption in a grid.

action.description: Carousel only: makes the card tappable.

aspect.description: Tile shape: 3:2, 1:1 or 3:4. Images are cropped to fill, centred.

src.description: Path of an image file stored with the document, relative to it (for example `assets/coast.jpg`). Remote URLs are refused in v1: add the image as a file first.

alt.description: Text alternative. Shown if the image fails to load and read by screen readers.

oneOf.title: button
oneOf.description: A button that runs an action.

variant.description: Visual weight. In a card's `actions` slot the default is `primary` for the first button and `secondary` for the rest; elsewhere `secondary`.

tone.description: `danger` marks a destructive action. A colour name only tints the button.

oneOf.title: choices
oneOf.description: A question with tappable answers; picking one runs its action.

prompt.description: The question, shown above the options.

layout.description: `list`: full-width rows with descriptions. `chips`: compact buttons that wrap.
